controls.name: RAW_AS_NATURAL
controls.detail: C1/C2 are full-frame synthetic packed RAW10 images; no natural-image corpus exists in this run -> claim_status labels stay proxy_not_natural/proxy_not_worst

controls.name: RAW_AS_WORST
controls.detail: C2 rand is incompressible raw but is not a proven worst case for all natural content; R3 stays G0_not_proven for the raw band, not a worst-case proof

controls.name: SINK_LIMITED_AS_G0
controls.detail: R3 S_ss=5189503.0 <= 6.25M would pass the arithmetic, but tail=109.8% of S_ss and the measured export rate is the sink cap; the run is labelled G0_not_proven, never G0 evidence

controls.name: SERIAL_AS_OVERLAP
controls.detail: R2-R1=1771435.0 cycles; the strict-serial S_ss is reported only in the serial column and may not populate the slot-free/overlapped result

controls.name: COLD_LATENCY_AS_THROUGHPUT
controls.detail: R1 L_cold=6449446 -> 75.355 MB/s < 77.76: t_exp(1)-t_rst is startup latency, not S_ss

controls.name: G25_DOWNGRADE
controls.detail: G25 is a reference column only (R1 G25_ref=meets_25_ref); no 1600x900 or other downgrade is proposed from G25

controls.name: AGGREGATE_2C
controls.detail: R1 c1s2 aggregate 2C=103.891 passes while per-stream C/2=51.946 fails; aggregate capacity is never substituted for per-stream

controls.name: CONTENT_MAP_MISMATCH
controls.detail: TB self-check bad=0; Python raw.bin->raw40->bytes mismatch C1=0 C2=0; the mismatch interpretation is rejected because the map checks are clean. Any bad>0 would void the content and force G0_not_proven instead of guessing
